note: Colorado County TX has no zoning authority over unincorporated private land. Its largest city, Columbus, publishes its zoning only as a PDF map (Zoning Map October 12 2023) with no GIS service found; the ArcGIS 'Zoning Districts' layer under the City of Columbus name on services8.arcgis.com is Columbus, Nebraska and is not used. Eagle Lake's official zoning map is kept in the city secretary's office, not published; Weimar's zoning map is not published as a queryable service. No ArcGIS REST zoning layer for Colorado County or its cities was found.
